label: Scripted lookup control
scope: Offline derived-corpus audit only; no API calls, paid requests or chain writes.
disclosure: These are the same authored arithmetic problems as court24-v2 with one shared worksheet prefix. Their exact text hashes and salts differ so the two claims do not reuse burned text hashes on one court. This does not create independent mathematical tasks, demonstrate novelty, or establish secrecy. Prompts, answers, formulas and deterministic salts are public.

construction.prefix: On a practice worksheet, a student reads this problem:
construction.prefix_applied: Exactly once before every original prompt and every rewrite prompt.
construction.salt_derivation: First 32 hexadecimal characters of SHA256(UTF-8("impeach/court24-v2-scripted|seed=240525|item=NN")); NN is the zero-padded item index.

arithmetic_method: Restricted Python AST (+, -, *, /, // and integer literals) evaluated using fractions.Fraction; no float rounding and no eval. Every // division is required to be exact, so it never truncates a quantity. Direct checks require the computed integer to equal each answer key. Envelope derivations also pass the existing CLI integer-only arithmetic linter.
